spl_product_data_elements: Camphora Kit Refill CAMPHORA LACTOSE SUCROSE CAMPHOR (NATURAL) CAMPHOR (NATURAL) white
purpose: USES To relieve the symptoms of coldness.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN Keep this and all medicines out of reach of children.
warnings: STOP USE AND ASK DOCTOR If symptoms persist/worsen or if pregnant/nursing, stop use and consult your practitioner.
dosage_and_administration: DIRECTIONS Adults: Dissolve 3 to 5 under the tongue three times a day or as directed by Lic. Practitioner. Take at greater intervals as condition subsides. Children: Dissolve 3 to 5 under the tongue three times a day or as directed by Lic. Practitioner. Take at greater intervals as condition subsides.
